1.

This criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner, aggrieved by the fact that the trial
Court instead of taking cognizance for offences under Section 420, 406, 120B, 323, 504 and 511 Ipc
has taken cognizance only for offences under (Uploaded on 09/10/2025 at 11:31:19 Am)
[2025:Rj-Jp:40722] (2 of 2) [Crlmp-3292/2013] Section 323, 504/120B Ipc.

The cognizance order was challenged by the petitioner by way of filing revision petition under Section 397 Cr.P.C.
which has also been dismissed by the revision Court on 05.03.2013.

2. This Court has received the report from Additional Civil Judge and Judicial Magistrate No. 12,
Jaipur Metro-2nd, which reveals that in the meanwhile, the trial was concluded by trial Court and the respondent-accused were convicted however, benefit of probation has been granted to them vide judgment dated 16.11.2019.
3.
In view of the fact that trial itself has been concluded, no cause of action to pursue the instant misc. petition survives and the same is hereby dismissed as having become infructuous.
(ANAND SHARMA),J NEERU/32
